tools.name: hinthealth_get_practice
tools.description: The practice this API key belongs to: id, name, address, email, phones, website and logo. GET /provider/practice.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_locations
tools.description: List the practice's locations with address, phone, virtual flag and location group. Optionally search near a postal code. GET /provider/locations.

tools.name: hinthealth_get_location
tools.description: One location by id (for example loc-ab12C345DeF6). GET /provider/locations/{id}.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_practitioners
tools.description: List the practice's practitioners with bio, NPI, specialties, panel size and limit, enrollment settings and locations. Optionally search near a postal code. GET /provider/practitioners.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_patients
tools.description: List patients (protected health information) one page at a time: name, date of birth, contact, address, membership status, autopay, past-due balance, practitioner and location. Archived patients are left out unless archived is true. The Social Security number is never returned. There is no bulk expo

tools.name: hinthealth_get_patient
tools.description: One patient by id (for example pat-ab12C345DeF6), protected health information: identity, contact, address, insurance, consents, memberships, sponsorships, emergency contact. The Social Security number is never returned. GET /provider/patients/{id}.

tools.name: hinthealth_match_patients
tools.description: Find existing patients that match a first and last name, optionally narrowed by email, date of birth or middle name. Reads only: nothing is created. Use it to look a patient up by name. POST /provider/patients/matching.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_patient_credits
tools.description: List a patient's account credits: amount, remaining balance, category and reason. GET /provider/patients/{patient_id}/credits.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_memberships
tools.description: List memberships: status, enrollment status, dates, rates in cents, plan, coupon, owner, member patients and upcoming bills. Filter by created or updated time (ISO 8601). GET /provider/memberships.

tools.name: hinthealth_get_membership
tools.description: One membership by id: plan, rates, dates, owner, member patients, cancellation and upcoming bills. GET /provider/memberships/{id}.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_plans
tools.description: List the practice's membership plans (id, name, type: company, retail or sponsor_fixed_fee). GET /provider/plans.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_coupons
tools.description: List membership coupons: code, discount (cents or percent), duration, redeemable window and archive state. GET /provider/coupons.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_charge_items
tools.description: List the practice's charge item catalog (the services and products a charge is made of): code, name, price in cents, category, stock. GET /provider/charge_items.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices (what patients are billed) with number, date, status, amounts in cents (total, due, paid), charges, location and owner. Filter by owner patient, location, status or created/updated time. GET /provider/customer_invoices.

tools.name: hinthealth_get_invoice
tools.description: One customer invoice by id with its charges, location, owner, amounts in cents and payment status. GET /provider/customer_invoices/{id}.

tools.name: hinthealth_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments made on one customer invoice: amount in cents, date, status, error message, memo, source and whether it was recorded outside Hint. GET /provider/customer_invoices/{id}/payments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_list_invoice_payments · Private data: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_list_patients, hinthealth_get_patient · Public sink: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_match_patients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_list_invoice_payments · Private data: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_list_patients, hinthealth_get_patient · Public sink: hinthealth_get_practice, hinthealth_match_patients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
